phase_label_basis: Inferred from marker timing and measured head kinematics: two rotation-dominant then two translation-dominant phases.
high_pass_definition: 1.0-s centered rolling median removed from display position and rotation-error vector; RMS of residual norm.
statistical_unit: marker-defined head-motion phase (n=4 active phases); baseline reported separately.
inference_policy: Paired descriptive evidence within one formal session; render frames are not independent population samples.
